mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals labor market strength, reducing equity risk premiums and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) above 110 and 1400 respectively indicates robust economic activity, increasing corporate earnings and equity valuations for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1400 and INDPRO > 110 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, high real sales (RSAFS) above 350,000 signals strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS > 350,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 110 indicates expanding manufacturing output, increasing corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 110 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy and robust labor markets, reducing equity risk for positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 137000 and FEDFUNDS < 5.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime, a monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.5% signals stable inflation expectations, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% monthly (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
